pages.title: Thermal Heater
pages.text: Burns fuel to heat a sealed room or an open camp.

pages.title: Fueling
pages.text: Right-click with coal, charcoal, blaze powder, coal blocks or $(l:heating/cryo_fuel)Cryo Fuel$(/l).$(br2)Redstone stops it and pauses fuel use.

pages.title: Sealed Rooms
pages.text: It heats the air first, then the walls and floor.$(br2)Bigger rooms take longer. See $(l:heating/room_climate)Room Heating$(/l).

pages.title: Shared Target
pages.text: Every heater in a room aims for $(bold)20°C$() and throttles as it warms. Core and fire heat count toward it.$(br2)More heaters warm faster, not hotter. A $(l:heating/thermostat)Thermostat$(/l) changes the target.

pages.title: Status Panel
pages.text: Shows $(bold)Heating$() or $(bold)Holding$(), burn percentage and fuel time left.$(br2)Good insulation lowers Holding.

pages.title: Airless Rooms
pages.text: Without air, heat reaches the walls slowly and vacuum still feels cold.$(br2)$(danger)A heater does not replace EVA.$()
Eight iron around a Thermal Core.$(br2)$(flavor)An iron box with a hot thing inside. ORSA billed the UN four billion credits for it.$()

pages.title: Specs
pages.text: $(li)Target: 20°C, or 10-30°C with a Thermostat$(li)Open camps: warms by proximity$(li)Extra fuel: frostmites, machinery$(li)Unloaded rooms pause$(li)Hot walls cool slowly; a $(l:heating/heat_vent)Heat Vent$(/l) helps

Without air, a heater stops at its target and passive sources can't push walls past their own temperature. Refilling air adds no heat. Resealing doesn't reset hot walls.$(br2)$(flavor)Can you name the heater? We cannot stop you.$()
